title: Similar to https://code.launchpad.net/~tobhe/ubuntu/+source/ubuntu-x1e-settings/+git/ubuntu-x1e-settings/+merge/491290 we probably want to catch all the sc8280x devices. They are pretty similar and require the same tweaks. Listing them individually doesn't scale as we have seen with x1e.
description: Similar to https://code.launchpad.net/~tobhe/ubuntu/+source/ubuntu-x1e-settings/+git/ubuntu-x1e-settings/+merge/491290 we probably want to catch all the sc8280x devices.
